comment: Whether the In-Store Delivery (in-store pickup) shipping method is offered at checkout.
modal: When Yes, the In-Store Delivery method is available as a delivery option during checkout. Can differ per website.

comment: The method name shown to shoppers for the In-Store Delivery option.
modal: The label shown for this specific In-Store Delivery method in the checkout shipping options. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The title shown to shoppers for the In-Store Delivery carrier.
modal: The heading shown for the In-Store Delivery carrier above its method at checkout. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The price charged for the In-Store Delivery method.
modal: The amount charged to the shopper when they choose In-Store Delivery. Can differ per website.

comment: The message shown when the In-Store Delivery method is unavailable.
modal: The error text displayed to shoppers when In-Store Delivery cannot be offered for their cart. Can differ per website or store view.
